description: Open federal comment periods (Federal Register) — Proposed rules, notices and interim rules whose public comment period is still open, sorted by comment deadline (soonest first), with days left, urgency (CLOSING NOW / SOON / OPEN), agencies, docket ids, RIN, significance flag, regulations.gov comment link and abstract. Params: q (topic) and/or agency (Federal Register slug like environmental-protection-agency, or short names epa, fda, sec, ftc, fcc, faa, irs, cms, osha, cfpb, usda...); optional type (proposed|notice|rule|all), days (closing within N days), limit (1-50, default 20). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: legal_open_comments
